name: How do you ensure complete odor removal after blood cleanup on walls?

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure complete odor removal after blood cleanup on walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Complete odor removal after blood cleanup is critical. After thoroughly cleaning and disinfecting surfaces, we employ several techniques to eliminate residual odors. This often includes using professional-grade deodorizers, air scrubbers with HEPA and activated carbon filters, and ozone generators in controlled environments. For heavily affected porous materials, an encapsulant or sealant may be applied to the walls to permanently trap any lingering microscopic odor-causing particles, ensuring the space smells fresh and clean.
